entities.summary: Jordan Daniel Morgan is an American-born naturalized Slovenian professional basketball player for Suwon KT Sonicboom of the Korean Basketball League (KBL). He played college basketball for the Michigan Wolverines. He represents the Slovenia basketball team internationally.
